page: OVHcloud d2-4 is a budget-tier virtual instance from the Discovery product family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 shared virtual x86_64 cores based on an Intel Haswell architecture clocked at 2.0 GHz, providing 16 MB of L3 cache. Memory capacity is allocated at 4.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core). Local storage consists of a bundled 50 GB NVMe SSD, while no discrete GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included in the base profile.

Benchmark evaluations place the d2-4 in entry-level tiers across compute and memory workloads. The instance registered a Geekbench single-core score of 752.0 and a multi-core score of 1320.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 1909.35, positioning raw compute capability in the lower 10 percent of recorded tests. Large-block uncached memory throughput achieved 15.06 GB/sec for reads and 13.91 GB/sec for writes. The included NVMe storage supports light local disk caching, yielding a static web serving throughput of 2.27 GB/sec and 1.82 million Redis SET operations per second.

Given its shared Haswell CPU allocation and modest resource allocation, the d2-4 emphasizes cost efficiency for non-critical environments rather than heavy data processing. It is best suited for entry-level workloads including development sandboxes, lightweight microservices, testing staging sites, and non-demanding background automation tasks.
